## PageWindow interface

Which items of a collection one page reads, in the collection's order.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface PageWindow
```

## Remarks

Positions are zero-based and the window is half-open: the page holds the items at `offset` up to, but not including, `offset + size`<!-- -->, and fewer when the collection ends first.

`anchor` makes continuation exact: it is the identifier of the last item the previous page returned, which sat at position `offset - 1`<!-- -->. The executor checks, in the same native request as the page read, that the item at `offset - 1` still has that identifier, and fails with `CollectionChangedError` when it does not, or when the collection no longer reaches that position. Items inserted or removed after the anchor are therefore harmless, and any move of the anchor is detected; a pair of compensating moves across the anchor goes undetected.
